description: Check whether Korean 10-digit business registration numbers are currently active, suspended, or closed via the National Tax Service (NTS) live API. Use this to verify a Korean supplier, customer, or counterparty before a transaction; business_registration_no can be obtained from kr_company_search, kr_company_profile, or kr_company_procurement results. Accepts 1–10 ten-digit numbers (hyphens allowed, e.g. "124-81-00998") and returns per number: status (active | suspended | closed | not_registered), original Korean status text, tax type, closure date if closed, and check timestamp. Combine with kr_company_procurement to inspect the entity's 12-month KONEPS public procurement track record. Limitations: queries an external government API in real time; submitted numbers are never stored or logged. Read-only, keyless.

business_numbers.description: 1 to 10 Korean 10-digit business registration numbers (hyphens allowed, e.g. "124-81-00998")
